name: Normal Operations
notes: Normal signal levels with natural variation.

name: Partial Silence Event
notes: Localized event causing partial reduction in signals.

name: Severe Silence
notes: Major disruption causing severe signal loss.

name: Complete Silence
notes: Total communication loss in affected area.

name: Low Baseline (False Silence)
notes: Rural cells with naturally low signal expectations.

name: Communication Outage
notes: Network/communication system failure. Other signals normal.

name: Network/Data Collection Failure
notes: Data collection system failure; mobility & communication unavailable.

name: Increased Activity
notes: High activity period; signals exceed expected levels.

name: Disaster Progression
notes: Disaster evolving from onset to peak to recovery.
